name: K7222.11/.21 neck-board bench

neck_c2.rationale: Unknown part SDVU 3312.4-6829.84; explore supply bypass sensitivity, not a decoded value.

q_is.rationale: Broad silicon switching BJT saturation-current family.

q_bf.rationale: SPICE low-injection BF proxy jointly bounded with IKF=5..20 A so the effective h21E stays within the SSY20 group-A 18..35 range at IC=500 mA and VCE=1.3 V. The group-A suffix mapping is inferred; this is not a full fitted model.

q_vaf.rationale: Finite Early effect; no original curve fitted.

q_ikf.rationale: High-current gain-rolloff proxy jointly bounded with BF=20..35 by the documented 0.5 A SSY20 group-A gain test; not a source-specified IKF. All BF/IKF corners are checked.

q_rb.rationale: Finite power-BJT base resistance proxy; ngspice's zero default is not a measured SSY20 value. Range is exploratory and requires stage sensitivity.

q_rc.rationale: Collector resistance proxy constrained jointly with RE by the SSY20 0.5 A/50 mA saturation test; not individually measured.

q_re.rationale: Emitter resistance proxy constrained jointly with RC by the SSY20 saturation test; not individually measured.

q_vje.rationale: Explicit silicon BJT junction-potential proxy based on the ngspice BJT table; exploratory spread, not an SSY20 limit.

q_mje.rationale: Explicit ngspice BJT emitter-junction grading proxy with exploratory spread.

q_vjc.rationale: Explicit silicon BJT collector-junction potential proxy based on the ngspice BJT table; exploratory spread.

q_mjc.rationale: Explicit ngspice BJT collector-junction grading proxy with exploratory spread.

q_eg.rationale: Explicit silicon energy-gap parameter from the ngspice BJT table with exploratory temperature-law spread.

q_xti.rationale: Explicit ngspice saturation-current temperature-exponent proxy with exploratory spread.

q_fc.rationale: Explicit ngspice forward-bias depletion-capacitance proxy with exploratory spread.

d_is.rationale: Broad rectifying diode family; not a fitted 1AD50 model.

d_bv.rationale: Explicit breakdown proxy: comparable 1N4148 has 100 V continuous/repetitive reverse rating; extra margin is unverified for the printed 1AD50.

d_ibv.rationale: Explicit SPICE breakdown-knee proxy; the 1N4148 data sheet does not specify IBV and the original 1AD50 rating is unknown.

d_vj.rationale: Explicit ngspice junction-potential default with provisional engineering spread; no original 1AD50 or 1AE15 limit.

d_m.rationale: Explicit ngspice grading-coefficient default; lower endpoint is a comparable Diodes Incorporated 1N4148W SPICE value, not an original-part limit.

d_fc.rationale: Explicit ngspice forward-bias depletion-capacitance default with provisional engineering spread.

d_eg.rationale: Explicit ngspice silicon activation-energy default with provisional temperature-law spread.

d_xti.rationale: Explicit ngspice saturation-current temperature-exponent default with provisional spread.

tube_cathode_c.rationale: Bench tube/socket capacitive load, not B31G22 measurement.

limitations: Only the 012-6891 neck board is connected; horizontal, vertical and power stages remain unimplemented.
External ideal bench supplies exercise a stage, not the complete monitor.
Device and C2 bounds are engineering assumptions, not measured confidence intervals.
No electron emission, heater dynamics or spark-gap discharge is included in this electrical stage.
